decisions.reason: The navigation and observation camera remains close to the core offer with its own page, so the sunk qualification costs and public commitment keep management persisting with it.
The modular multi-model camera line is heavily invested, prominently promoted and central to the announced push toward flexible compact sensors, so it stays.
The miniaturized LiDAR is only mentioned on the website, but it underpins the docking and small-satellite strategy and its costly space qualification justifies continued commitment.
The radiation-hard camera line was launched in 2024 with its own page and several models, so it is freshly and visibly committed and too early to judge.
The asteroid camera is new and tied to long mission timelines, so weak early visibility can be put down to temporary causes, and management stays committed.
